note: Features whose Playwright spec exists but cannot yet cover the whole §16.2 scenario. Each entry says what is pending and which task owns it. Never fake or skip a test to remove an entry: finish the scenario, then delete the entry. scripts/check-e2e-coverage.mjs counts these as PARTIAL; E9X_E2E_GATE=strict fails while any remains.

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.6): the author builds a TOEIC test on the screen part by part from published question groups, the screen checks it against the exam (a count that differs warns, a missing skill blocks the review), the number of resumes is set per test, the test is published only by a review that waits for its groups (a draft group refuses the approval), and an edit makes version 2 while version 1 stays PUBLISHED (the review is run by seed.reviewVersion, the real ReviewService, until the review screens exist). 'Gắn bảng quy đổi ghi đè' is done (W10 T6): the SYS_ADMIN attaches it on /admin/score-overrides, the author finds it on the test builder screen and writes its rows, the result uses it (asserted in e2e/specs/cms/F15-score-tables.spec.ts). Pending: only the full-size tests 'TOEIC 200 câu' / 'IELTS 4 kỹ năng' with every count right. They need ~100+ published questions of seven TOEIC types and four IELTS skills, with audio and images: the Excel import (P2.7) takes one question type per file and has fixtures only for TOEIC_P5 and IELTS_R_HEADINGS, and every imported draft would still need its own review and a group before it can sit in a test. Building those workbooks with their media zips and the review of each is a task of its own, not done in W10 T6.
features.owner: P2.7 (import: full-size tests), the override screen (an administrator's)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.5, W10 T6): the author writes the IELTS Writing Task 2 skill on the screen (rubric, criteria, prompt template with the four variables, scored samples, result schema that must declare every criterion), the dry run calls the AI grader through the fake Gemini and shows its schema-valid answer without saving anything, a review publishes it, a teacher of the exam reads the published one and a learner never does, an edit makes version 2. Pending: 'dùng khi chấm' asserted inside the F16 spec itself: after the skill is published, one IELTS Writing Task 2 answer is sat and graded, the evaluation must name the published skill version, and a version-2 draft must not be used until published. Missing: seed.grading.ai(attemptId) returns no skill version id per evaluation (section, model, tokens, cost, band, result only), so the version cannot be asserted without extending the seed endpoint; the F16 skill is also owned by an organisation, which needs an org-owned published IELTS test and an entitled learner, plus the two-minute late-sync wait. F34 covers the grading job with English9x's published skill but does not assert the version.
